einzeiler: Hard lessons and relationship truths from 30 years of marriage.
kurzfassung: Mel and her husband Chris discuss the hard lessons learned over 30 years of marriage. They explore challenges like feeling like roommates, handling stress, and overcoming resentment. Additionally, they share actionable strategies and rituals to rebuild connection during difficult seasons.
stichpunkte: How stress turns a partner into someone to blame
The cycle of resentment, criticism, silence, and shutdown
The concept of normal marital hatred and triggered old wounds
How to soften during conflict instead of hardening or retreating
Simple rituals used to rebuild connection and manage calendars
Assessing if a relationship has the foundation for decades of change
beschreibung:
Today is Mel’s 30th wedding anniversary. And she couldn't think of a better way to celebrate than to have a sit down conversation with her husband Chris about the lessons they've learned along the way.

This episode isn’t about the highlights – it’s talking about the hard lessons that have shaped their marriage these last 30 years.

Mel and Chris unpack the years where they felt more like roommates than a married couple and they share stories from when stress got the best of them.

They get into how resentment and bitterness created a distance that kept growing, and how they found their way back to each other.

They talk about what they wish they knew sooner and the expert advice that has helped them the most.

Mel and Chris also break down their relationship truths into small, actionable things you can do to make your relationship stronger today.

In this episode, you’ll learn:

-How to tell when stress has turned your partner from your favorite person into the person you blame.

-Why resentment, criticism, silence, and shutdown can become a cycle that quietly pulls couples apart.

-What “normal marital hatred” means and why your partner can trigger old wounds you have never fully dealt with.

-How to soften during conflict instead of hardening, attacking, or retreating.

-The simple rituals Mel and Chris use to rebuild connection, including notes, touch, walks, shared meals, and weekly calendar check-ins.

-How to know whether your relationship has the foundation to grow with you through decades of change.

Whether you are newly in love, decades into a marriage, going through a rough patch, or wondering if your relationship is going to make it through a rough season, this conversation will give you a more honest and useful way to think about lasting love.

Because the truth is, a strong relationship isn't built by avoiding the hard seasons. It’s built by learning the lessons from them and finding your way back to each other when those seasons come.
